statements.cited_system: electrocatalysts for oxygen- and hydrogen-involving energy conversion reactions
statements.quote: A significant achievement in the design of electrocatalysts is the identification of the correlation between binding energies of reactants/intermediates and activity as a basis to rationalise experimental findings.

statements.quote: The synthesis of CCSS particles while adjusting the composition, size, shape, and morphology is challenging; however, many innovative techniques have been reported recently.[, , ]

statements.attributed: suggested that for the oxygen reduction reaction (ORR), the binding geometry will change between on-top (*OH and *OOH) and threefold hollow site adsorption (*O) for the different intermediates at CCSS surfaces
statements.quote: Recent models suggest that for the oxygen reduction reaction (ORR), the binding geometry will change between on‐top (*OH and *OOH) and threefold hollow site adsorption (*O) for the different intermediates at CCSS surfaces, and hence also the number and nature of binding peaks will vary between the reaction steps. This unique concept lowers the probability of the presence of the best binding peak, but also enables unique opportunities to optimise different intermediate steps individually, hence breaking the traditional scaling relation.

statements.attributed: described how the combined current response of all sites within one binding peak of the BEDP yields one current wave in a voltammogram with overpotential related to binding energy position and plateau intensity related to the number of sites
statements.quote: The combined current response of all sites within one binding peak of the BEDP yields one “current wave” in a voltammogram (Figure 2 a, bottom) with the overpotential related to the binding energy position of the peak maximum and the plateau intensity related to the integral, i.e., the number of sites within the peak. Since the plateau current is not due to mass transport limitation but due to the maximum attainable turnover at the respective sites, it is possible to observe more than one current wave in the corresponding voltammograms.

statements.quote: Furthermore, Cr‐Mn‐Fe‐Co‐Ni showed good activity with respect to the ORR,[, , ] even though all individual elements are far from a good volcano position.

statements.quote: Recent work introduced the importance of Bader charges and thus electron donor–acceptor interactions between the elements to predict binding energy shifts in alloys. The overlap of orbitals, which is affected by atom size differences, will also play a role.

statements.quote: From an experimental perspective, an element combination screening could focus on equiatomic compositions and consider only the overpotential position of the first current wave to identify promising candidates, followed by composition optimisation to increase their current intensity, according to the concept illustrated in Figure 2 a.

statements.attributed: found that particles were amorphous but still highly active
statements.quote: Particles in one of the earliest studies were amorphous but still highly active.

statements.attributed: suggested that the composition is more important to achieve higher activity than size and crystal structure
statements.quote: In another study, it was suggested that the composition is more important to achieve higher activity than size and crystal structure. For the particle size effect, the increasing contribution of edge and corner sites with decreasing NP diameters implies the enhanced contribution of different geometrical arrangements of sites where the electronic interaction between the different elements is altered and the combined analysis of geometry, electronic interaction, and stability should be considered.

statements.attributed: demonstrated that the huge variety in different sites implies that not all theoretically possible sites can be present at a single NP
statements.quote: Further, it was demonstrated that the huge variety in different sites implies that not all theoretically possible sites can be present at a single NP. Since the immense number of NPs in a catalyst powder averages out this effect, this does not affect the overall performance, yet one should be aware that analysis of a single NP is not necessarily representative for the whole NP population.

statements.attributed: stated that the scaling relation inherently lowers the catalytic activity by about six orders of magnitude compared to an ideal catalyst
statements.quote: The scaling relation inherently lowers the catalytic activity by about six orders of magnitude compared to an ideal catalyst, even though catalysts were found with the best compromising binding energies located precisely at the top of the volcano. Since the reaction intermediates do not desorb from the surface, with the exception of H2O2 in the case of the 2+2 electron transfer pathway during the ORR, the cascade concept cannot be applied.
